description: This file contains a React hook and utility function for progressive batch processing in React applications. It defines a utility to process items in batches using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, along with a React hook to manage UI state related to this processing, such as progress and cancellation.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch application, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback, with methods to start and cancel processing, and hooks for progress updates and completion.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that wraps the progressive expand controller, managing UI state such as whether the process is running, progress percentage, counts of processed items, and providing functions to start processing with a set of items or cancel it.
